summary: Execute an authorized release plan and establish the identity of the deployed revision.

inputs.name: release-plan
inputs.description: Immutable release identity, target, preconditions, rollout, and recovery controls.

inputs.name: verification-report
inputs.description: Checks and evidence bound to the exact candidate and inputs.

inputs.name: migration-plan
inputs.description: Current migration plan evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: observability-plan
inputs.description: Current observability plan evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

inputs.name: security-assessment
inputs.description: Current security assessment evidence and its material constraints, when selected by risk or policy.

completion_checks: Target, artifact, authorization, and deployment preconditions match the release plan.
The deployment receipt and independently observed target revision are recorded without inferring health.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
